hook: You assembled it yourself, so now you think it's worth way more. It isn't.

headline: YOU
BUILT IT.
SO WHAT?

scenes.say: You assembled it yourself, so now you think it's worth way more. It isn't.
scenes.show: You built it. It's not worth more.

scenes.say: The IKEA effect: effort makes us overvalue what we made.
Norton, Mochon and Ariely asked people what they'd pay for the same storage box.
scenes.note: Source: Norton, Mochon & Ariely (2012), Journal of Consumer Psychology

scenes.say: It's why we can't kill our own projects, even when the numbers say they're failing.
Judge your work through someone who didn't build it.

takeaway: Judge your work through someone who didn't build it.
